name: Std.Antisymm

source.code:
/-- `Antisymm r` says that `r` is antisymmetric, that is, `r a b → r b a → a = b`. -/
class Antisymm (r : α → α → Prop) : Prop where
  /-- An antisymmetric relation `r` satisfies `r a b → r b a → a = b`. -/
  antisymm (a b : α) : r a b → r b a → a = b
